name: Testing Examples
summary: Free open source HTML fixtures for practicing browser automation, plus eleven sibling demo repos that exercise them.
description: The home page is a deliberately plain, stable page of elements with known ids, names, classes, link text, lists, and form inputs, meant to be found by Selenium WebDriver, WebdriverIO, Playwright, and similar tools. Five sibling repositories — generic locator-strategy walkthroughs — drive a browser directly against this site's home page, and its fixture markup (the ids, names, classes, and text under "Id Examples" through "Form Input Examples") is a contract those five repos depend on exactly. Six further sibling repos drive the same kinds of tools against a real public site, nhs.wales, instead, and do not depend on this site's markup.
